Perks & builds

PERKULATOR

Give a familiar car another useful ability.

ORIGINAL · APEX GRIP+INSTALLED · TORQUE

Example: Race Car with TORQUE

Unlock: 2,000 trophies · Perkulator.

Install

Open PERKULATOR in GARAGE. Choose an unlocked, installable perk and put it on the selected car. It runs alongside that car’s ORIGINAL perk.

What is available?

Both the source car and its perk must be unlocked. Available perks appear directly: no cloning, currency or duplicate collection is needed. LEGENDARY perks stay with their cars.

Replace or remove

Each car has one INSTALLED slot. Installing another perk replaces that slot; removing it leaves the ORIGINAL perk intact. A car cannot install its own perk twice.

Check the combination

Look for a useful interaction, not just a rarity. A stat-building perk has less to add when that attribute is already at its ordinary limit.
